titulo: Free Professional Installation and Zero-Leak Tightness Check
descripcion: Our delivery riders are technicians trained in the safe handling of LPG. We install your gas cylinder, attach the Click-On regulator and carry out the active foam test to certify absolute hermetic safety.
paso_1_desc: We verify that your flexible hose has no dry cracks, cuts, or expiration.
paso_2_desc: We inspect the junction of the regulator and cylinder before turning on your stove.
paso_3_titulo: Safe Removal and Recycling of Empty Cylinder
paso_3_desc: We take away the empty cylinder without dirtying your kitchen or scraping your floors.
